excerpts.text: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited, Objects of the Issue (printed p. 117). Fresh issue up to INR 1,830.57 million gross. Proposed allocation: INR 1,250.00 million for repayment or prepayment of borrowings; INR 157.70 million for acquisition of capital equipment under existing lease arrangements with Siemens Financial Services; general corporate purposes to be finalised. Net proceeds are gross proceeds less applicable issue expenses.

Restated statement of assets and liabilities (printed p. 318). INR million. Columns: 30 June 2026 | 31 March 2026 | 31 March 2025 | 31 March 2024. Total assets: 5261.08 | 5714.66 | 4582.05 | 3502.08. Total equity: 1366.16 | 1215.81 | 830.47 | 543.59. Non-current borrowings: 641.68 | 522.89 | 392.25 | 406.91. Current borrowings: 2095.22 | 2861.65 | 2377.36 | 1934.69. Cash and cash equivalents: 91.69 | 109.31 | 20.35 | 1.41.

Restated profit and loss (printed p. 319). INR million. Columns: quarter ended 30 June 2026 | FY ended 31 March 2026 | FY ended 31 March 2025 | FY ended 31 March 2024. Revenue from operations: 3970.80 | 12668.18 | 10557.07 | 7552.59. Profit after tax: 150.75 | 305.39 | 286.72 | 211.38. Quarterly figures are not annualised.

Restated statement of cash flows (printed p. 320). INR million. Columns: quarter ended 30 June 2026 | FY ended 31 March 2026 | FY ended 31 March 2025 | FY ended 31 March 2024. Net cash from operating activities: 723.05 | 102.17 | 320.90 | 114.87. Net cash used in investing activities: -6.80 | -350.27 | -417.62 | -528.50. Net cash from or used in financing activities: -733.88 | 337.06 | 115.65 | 395.63.

scope: Verified transcription of selected pages from the issuer's 21 October 2026 RHP. This is a versioned document reference, not a full-document audit or live financial statement.
